events.strDescriptionEN:
The Qatar 1812 KM for the 2026 FIA World Endurance Championship (WEC) season has been rescheduled and will now take place from 22 to 24 October 2026 at the Lusail International Circuit. 
Originally slated to open the season in late March, the event was postponed due to regional geopolitical instability. It will now serve as the penultimate round (Round 7) of the 2026 championship.
